event.title: Crossfire
event.text: You jump straight into the middle of a battle. Ships of both sides are trading fire across the cluster, and nobody is checking whose side your squad is on.

choice.text: Hold back and wait for it to end.

outcome.text: The fighting moves on. When it's over, the wrecks it left behind are worth converting.
The fighting comes to you. One side decides you're with the other.

choice.text: Cloak and slip through the battle.

outcome.text: You cross the cluster between the two lines, unseen by both.

choice.text: Charge your drives and get out of the way.

outcome.text: A stray volley rakes one of your ships before you clear the battle.

event.title: Left Behind
event.text:
A crippled {race} warship drifts at the edge of the fighting, left behind when its side pulled back. Its captain hails you, out of breath.
"We've got wounded and no medbay left. Take them, and you can take whatever we've got left in the hold."

choice.text: Take the wounded aboard.

outcome.text: Your crews carry the wounded across. The captain keeps the promise, and when the ship's own people come back for it, one of the wounded asks to stay with you.

choice.text: Strip their hold and leave them.

outcome.text: You take what's in the hold. The captain watches you go and says nothing at all.

choice.text: Leave them for their own side to find.

event.title: Both Sides
event.text:
A trader's barge sits exactly between the two front lines, flying no colors, selling weapons to whoever comes alongside. Its owner hails you cheerfully.
"Wars are good for business. Yours could be next. Looking to buy?"

choice.text: Buy a weapon.

outcome.text: The trader sells you a weapon still warm from the last customer's test fire.

choice.text: Copy their buyer list and sell it to one side.

outcome.text: Your probe copies the trader's records. One side pays well to learn who has been arming the other.
The trader catches your probe and calls in a favor from a buyer.

choice.text: Move on.

event.title: Neutral Ground
event.text: Captains from both sides of the war have agreed to talk, but only through someone who belongs to neither. Your squad is the only neutral party in the cluster.

choice.text: Carry their messages back and forth.

outcome.text: It takes most of a day. When it's done, both sides pull back from the border, and each pays you something for the trouble.
One side uses the talks to move its ships into position. The ceasefire breaks with you in the middle of it.

choice.text: Let {crew} record the agreement, so neither side can deny it.

outcome.text: {crew} records every word, and both sides know the record cannot be lost. Neither side can break the agreement without everyone knowing. Both pay you, and the border goes quiet.

choice.text: Stay out of it.

event.title: The Column
event.text:
A long column of refugee ships is crossing the cluster, far from the space they came from. Their lead ship hails you.
"We've been running for weeks. We don't need saving. We just need someone to tell us which way the clusters are still standing."

choice.text: Share your charts with them.

outcome.text: The column turns onto the route you gave them. As the last ship passes, its pilot asks to stay with your squad instead.

choice.text: Trade your charts for their supplies.

outcome.text: They pay what they can spare, which isn't much.

choice.text: Wish them luck.

event.title: The Camp
event.text:
An old station has become a refugee camp: people of half a dozen races crammed into every corridor, waiting for a ship that can take them further. Its organizer hails you, exhausted.
"We can't all leave. But if you can help even some of us, help us."

choice.text: Give them Mawjig for their transports.

outcome.text: Two transports fuel up and leave with as many people as they can carry. The organizer thanks you twice.

choice.text: Let {crew} cover the transports with a Supershield on the way out.

outcome.text: {crew} flies escort beside the transports, the Supershield wrapped around the column. Every ship gets out. The camp sends you what it can, and a volunteer.

choice.text: Let {crew} keep a record of everyone here.

outcome.text: {crew} records every name in the camp. "Whatever happens to them, they will not be forgotten," {crew} says. The camp has little to give, but gives it anyway.

choice.text: You can't help them all.

event.title: No One To Fly It
event.text:
An Azurethea skiff full of refugees drifts with its drive cold. Its only pilot was hurt in the last jump, and nobody else aboard knows how to fly it.
"Take us to the next safe cluster," one of them asks softly. "Then keep the skiff. We will travel on with the others from there."

choice.text: Fly them to safety and keep the skiff.

outcome.text: One of your crew flies the skiff the whole way. At the next safe cluster the refugees step off with their pilot, and the skiff unfolds its wings beside your squad.

choice.text: Give them directions and leave them.

event.title: End of the Line
event.text:
A shipyard is closing for good. Its last crew hails you before they leave.
"We can do one more job before we go. Half price. We'd rather the parts go into a ship that's still flying."

choice.text: Pay for a refit.

outcome.text: The yard's last crew works through the night. One of your systems runs better than it ever has.

choice.text: Pay for hull repairs.

outcome.text: They patch your hulls with the yard's last plating.

choice.text: Wish them luck.

event.title: A Spare Hull
event.text:
A shipyard has a finished scout cruiser in its cradle and no buyer for it. The foreman hails you.
"Its owner never came back for it. I'd rather sell it cheap than watch the collapse take it."

choice.text: Buy the ship.

outcome.text: The cruiser rolls out of its cradle and falls in with your squad.

choice.text: Not today.

event.title: The Last Broadcast
event.text: A world at the edge of the collapse is sending one message on every channel, over and over: the names of everyone who couldn't get off it.

choice.text: Record it and send it to The Colony Ship.

outcome.text: You record the whole list and pass it on. The Colony Ship answers with a single line: "We'll carry them too."

choice.text: Let {crew} keep every name.

outcome.text: {crew} records the list, name by name. "Now they are somewhere," {crew} says.

choice.text: Jump on.

event.title: Everything Must Go
event.text: A trading hub is selling everything it has before the collapse reaches it. Prices mean nothing anymore. The last traders only want enough Mawjig to jump.

choice.text: Buy what they have.

outcome.text: You pay what they ask, and they load more into your holds than it's worth.

choice.text: Give them the Mawjig to jump, and take nothing.

outcome.text: The last traders thank you and leave. On their way out, they open the hub's stores to your squad.

choice.text: Move on.

event.title: Stowaways
event.text: Halfway through the jump checks, your crew find people hiding in a cargo hold: a family who slipped aboard at your last stop, terrified of being sent back.

choice.text: Let them stay.

outcome.text: They cry with relief. One of them, an engineer, starts work on your ship before you've even finished talking.

choice.text: Leave them at the next safe cluster.

outcome.text: You set them down where it's safe for now. They thank you anyway.
